scope: Software/reporting readiness and bounded evidence only; no campaign or scientific performance claim.

periodicity.root_cause: The workflow had mixed the evaluator contract identity with the cycle-primary data contract. PeriodicDetectorV2 intentionally compares frozen REFERENCE_PERIODIC_CONVERGENCE_V1 primary records; the detector/checkpoint/report identity is REFERENCE_PERIODIC_CONVERGENCE_V2.
periodicity.correction: Keep the primary data contract V1; bind evaluator V2 contract, detector source SHA-256, threshold SHA-256 and threshold table separately in new run/checkpoint/result. Persist evaluation status, termination reason, cycles/comparison counts, accepted period and comparison index; full residuals/thresholds remain in per-cycle outcomes.
periodicity.compatibility: Prior checkpoint bindings without these V2 evaluator hashes are rejected for resume. Historical receipts and NOT_EVALUATED fields remain unchanged. Old results without the new diagnostic object remain readable through the legacy import path.

geometry.finding: Existing IntegratedEngine2T._geometry uses exact configured reference RPM for the power-valve map, preserving reconstructed RPM for kinematics. Reconstructed endpoint RPM can be one ULP outside the map (e.g. 999.9999999999999 or 5000.000000000001) and falsely reject a valid configured endpoint.
geometry.action: Existing numerical fix verified; no solver or physical source change made in V2.
geometry.verification: At 1000, 3000 and 5000 RPM and three crank angles, area is invariant to adjacent nextafter RPM values; invalid map endpoints remain fail-closed.

performance.code_change: Removed json.dumps/json.loads full-primary roundtrip when adding output-only periodicity metadata after the canonical primary has already been compressed and hashed. The workflow attaches metadata to its single-use in-memory primary; persisted primary bytes are captured before this step.
performance.limit: Component-only measured change on one archived production-size primary; no end-to-end full-case or campaign speedup claimed.

mesh.setup: Reproducible 1/2/4/8 cells-per-section candidate configurations, canonical hashes, exact named geometry preservation, conservative extensive-state checks, accepted-step native phase extraction, per-resolution audited receipt builder, raw scalar deltas and explicit offline-only phase interpolation.

robustness.independent_primary_replay_and_conservat: Verified in two-cycle resume integration test; audit recomputed true.

bounded_profile.measurement_limit: Short 5.125-degree segment and one archived cycle replay; not a complete cycle or full 48-cell before/after benchmark. No exhausted run was resumed.
bounded_profile.self_time_note: Percentages classify exclusive cProfile self time in that separate measurement phase; grouped timing excludes nested cumulative time. The full audit wrapper consumed 242.67 s inclusive in the instrumented stored-primary replay.
